correctness.rationale: Huang Definition 1.1 models equivariant Borel Floer theory by a finite free complex C over the DVR R=F2[[q]]. Its truncated coefficient theory is C⊗R A_N with A_N=R/(q^N), not merely H(C)⊗A_N; thus the universal coefficient theorem contains both a tensor term and an adjacent Tor_1 term. For H(C)≈R^r⊕Σ_j R/(q^{a_j}), both tensor and Tor_1 of each torsion cyclic with A_N have F2-dimension min(a_j,N), while each free R summand contributes N. Therefore h_N=rN+2Σ_j min(N,a_j) and Δ_N=h_N-h_(N-1)=r+2#{j:a_j≥N}; Δ_N-Δ_(N+1)=2#{j:a_j=N}. The localized free rank r=2^(c-1) follows from the published equivariant branched-cover localization input in Huang introduction (for |L|=c). Increments are nonincreasing, have parity r and eventually r; the ungraded module type is reconstructed. This is correct finite-rank homological algebra for each based link and does not recover torsion grading, extension data, or a link-specific numerical spectrum.
